additional_info.subject: Update
additional_info.body:
As per product issue document :
Issue : HMI Touch latency
1. Check if Dlogic controller update has been done
2. Advise the region to set an overnight automatic reboot (every two days at least)
3. Do not advise to replace HMI. There is no evidence that the issue is HW related yet.
4. If possible, ask for timestamp of the issue
5. Fwd to ES
